RateLimiting.//: Generous, not disabled — a developer testing several seeded accounts by hand shouldn't hit the production login/refresh budget, but the policy itself stays exercised.

Email.//: No provider account exists, so nothing is sent locally: each message is written to backend/src/BookSpace.Api/sent-emails as an .eml file, which opens in any mail client. Those files contain live activation links — the directory is gitignored. FromAddress and FromDisplayName are inherited from appsettings.json.
